artifacts.rights_basis: The repository's MIT license covers software and project additions, but its README traces the Greek data through Wong to CATSS. MIT is not treated as relicensing the access-restricted upstream text/data.

edition.notes: Used only to cross-check normalized lexeme handling, especially the malformed raw CATSS Genesis 25:22 lemma. It is a derivative lineage, not an independent textual witness.
